scripts.dev:electron: npm run compile:electron && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run compile:electron
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const p = path.join('node_modules', 'node-pty', 'prebuilds'); if (fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.readdirSync(p).forEach(d => { const helper = path.join(p, d, 'spawn-helper'); if (fs.existsSync(helper)) { try { fs.chmodSync(helper, 0o755); } catch(e){} } }); }"
